lines.zh: 我四足踏在岩上，爪子响。
lines.en: My four feet drum on the rock.

lines.zh: 蓝色的鳞片在光下很亮。
lines.en: My blue scales shine in the light.
I work my way down the ridge.
My tail sweeps the rubble.
I press up the slope step by step.
I raise my head and taste the wind.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，从窄岩缝钻过。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze through the narrow gap.
I don't walk fast; I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 我的蓝鳞一发热，就喷出巨焰。
lines.en: My blue scales heat and I spit Mega Flame.
I head for the shade below.
I turn, and the path is narrow.
I shake the scales on my neck.
I stop on the stone and look out.
I climb a stretch higher.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩上，尾巴绕过来。
lines.en: I lie on the rock, tail curled round.
My breath comes out warm.
I stare down into the valley.
This rock is hot from the sun.
A blue core dragon that can carry a rider.
I'm listening to the mountain.
My claws grip the stone.
A few birds circle far off.

lines.zh: 我趴在岩上，让太阳晒鳞。
lines.en: I lie on the rock and let the sun warm my scales.
Some of my scales are worn.
I shift my body around.

lines.zh: 我趴在这块热岩上等对手。
lines.en: This sun-warmed rock is a fine place to wait for a rival.
The wind up here is hard.
I shift my forepaws.

lines.zh: 我看得出，能爬上这山脊的没几个。
lines.en: Few creatures make it up this ridge.
My snout comes level with you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的喘气，顺山风上来。
lines.en: Your breathing carries up on the mountain wind.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整个盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers all of you.
We needn't fight.
Are you getting on my back?
Let me have a look at you first.
This tail isn't for show.
Where are your hands.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，你整条手臂都装得下。
lines.en: I open my mouth wide enough for your whole arm.
You're too close to my teeth.
A crack runs through my blue scales.
You have not drawn your blade; I noticed.
Wind runs between us.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，山里有回音。
lines.en: I call out, and the mountain answers.
Ask if you have something to ask.
I step back once and hold.
I growl and pull back.
A scale has cracked.
My hide is thick; I can take it.
My blue scales gleam in the sun.
I dig my claws in.
A scale has flipped up.

lines.zh: 我还在站着，蓝鳞上都是灰。
lines.en: I am still standing; ash covers my blue scales.

lines.zh: 我把身子伏低，鳞还在抖。
lines.en: I crouch low, my scales still trembling.

lines.zh: 鳞片碎了一块，我记下这笔。
lines.en: A scale chips; I will remember this blow.
Meat — I smell it.
I lower my head and lean in.
Barely enough to touch my teeth.
Let go; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我一口就没了，蓝鳞蹭着碎石。
lines.en: One gulp and it is gone; my blue scales scrape the gravel.
I'm in no hurry to swallow.
Is there any more meat?

lines.zh: 肉，我闻到了，你撒手我来拿。
lines.en: I smell meat — let go and I will take it.
It's raw — perfect.

lines.zh: 我这条蓝鳞的龙，连骨头都嚼碎。
lines.en: A blue-scaled dragon chews even the bones.

lines.zh: 蓝核龙一低头，影子盖住你。
lines.en: When the blue Coredramon dips its head, its shadow covers you.
Hold the meat higher.

lines.zh: 你撞上我前腿，像撞石柱。
lines.en: You hit my foreleg like a stone pillar.
My feet didn't shift at all.

lines.zh: 我这身蓝鳞，是被核晶烧出来的。
lines.en: These blue scales were burned in by core crystal.
I turn aside to make room.
Between us we've kicked stones loose.
Your hand scraped a scale.
My scales don't even shift.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的鳞不晃。
lines.en: You stand too close; my scales do not shift.

lines.zh: 我身上蓝鳞擦过你的肩甲。
lines.en: My blue scales scrape past your shoulder plate.
Keep walking on.

lines.zh: 这山里还有别的数码兽。
lines.en: There are other Digimon in these mountains.
I saw one in a crevice once.
We didn't fight.
We looked at each other a while.

lines.zh: 我们对望一眼，就各走各路。
lines.en: One look passes between us, then we part ways.
There aren't many of us.
I have an old wound on my back.
It didn't come from that one.
My scales are still growing.
One day I'll change shape.

lines.zh: 我用牙把它从碎石里拣出来。
lines.en: I pick it out of the rubble with my teeth.
I pin it under a claw.

lines.zh: 我牙一磕，这东西硬得像铁。
lines.en: My teeth clack; this thing is hard as iron.

lines.zh: 我衔着它，慢慢走回岩上。
lines.en: I carry it in my teeth back up onto the rock.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它扔上蓝鳞的背。
lines.en: I toss it up onto my blue-scaled back.

lines.zh: 我没抓稳，它一路滚下坡。
lines.en: It slips my claws and tumbles down the slope.
I fetch it back from the slope.

lines.zh: 这块东西咬不动，我丢开。
lines.en: This thing won't break under my teeth; I drop it.

lines.zh: 我把它推到你靴子前面。
lines.en: I nudge it in front of your boots.
Take this one.
There's a shape on the slope.
Blue core dragon, fire in my throat.

lines.zh: 我把蓝鳞的前身贴到岩面。
lines.en: I press my blue-scaled forebody to the rock.
My eyes don't leave it.
It's a Digimon too.
I've waited for this one.
My scales rise.

lines.zh: 我压低前身，一步步逼近。
lines.en: I lower my forebody and close in step by step.

lines.zh: 它没退，反倒朝我低下了头。
lines.en: It doesn't back off; it lowers its head at me.
Good — then no more courtesy.
I'm ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的火，把岩面烤干了。
lines.en: The fire in my throat has already dried the rock.
I circle along the slope.
My foot crushed a stone.

lines.zh: 它站在崖上，影子落在我背上。
lines.en: It stands on the cliff, its shadow on my back.
I raise my head; its shadow is there.
My core glows in my chest.
It backed to the cliff edge, nowhere left.
I take two strides forward.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下扫过碎石。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the rubble again and again.
It raised a forelimb.
I turn my head aside.
My claws bite the rock.
This goes into its flank.

lines.zh: 我低头，一口咬穿了它的甲。
lines.en: I lower my head and bite clean through its armor.
My claws rake it.

lines.zh: 我的头角撞在它胸口上。
lines.en: My horned head slams into its chest.

lines.zh: 它被我顶得在岩上翻倒。
lines.en: My charge rolls it over on the rock.
Heat in my throat, and the fire comes.
My teeth only scrape its armor.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，把它掀上半空。
lines.en: I whip my head and throw it into the air.
It's grabbed my horn.
I pull back and reset.
Its blood is on the stone.

lines.zh: 我顶着爪子，再往前压一步。
lines.en: I dig in my claws and press one step further.
There's still fire in my throat.
I rise from behind the ridge.
Blue scales catch the light.
This mountain ground is mine to patrol.
First I take the wind.
My claws dig into the rock.
I look down the mountain.

lines.zh: 我从山脊站起，碎石从鳞上滚落。
lines.en: I rise from the ridge, rubble sliding off my scales.
Something is moving below.
I start down.

lines.zh: 山谷里，我一声吼滚得很远。
lines.en: My roar rolls far down the valley.
The mountain answers.
I head for the sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走下坡，四足很稳。
lines.en: I come down the slope steadily on all fours.

lines.zh: 我把爪子从岩里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my claws out of the rock.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的鳞，滋滋响。
lines.en: The flames hiss against my scales.

lines.zh: 我从山脊滚下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I roll off the ridge and land heavily.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils and I kick hard.
The blast slams me into the cliff.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩，卡在鳞缝里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my scales.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的动作压住。
lines.en: That force pins my movement.

lines.zh: 饿了几天，我连坡都爬不上去。
lines.en: Days without food; I can't even climb.

lines.zh: 雷落在我蓝鳞上，火花四溅。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my blue scales and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 山壁没了，我直直坠下去。
lines.en: The cliff is gone and I drop straight down.
